topic.angle: A rapid shift from feudal rule to a modern state

card.title: The country that retired its samurai

panels.text: By 1868, a group led by Satsuma and Chōshū had overthrown the shogunal system. On 3 January 1868, Emperor Meiji declared power restored to the Imperial House.

In 1871 the new government told Japan's feudal lords it had decided to abolish their domains, without consulting them. In return they kept a small portion of their income and joined a new aristocracy.
In 1873 it brought in nationwide conscription: every man would serve four years in the armed forces from the age of 21.
The twist: the samurai class dissolved, and feudalism ended. Railways, communications and industry grew in its place.
